001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
010import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
011import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
012
013/**
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class PropTransitiveUnreachable extends Propagator<SetVar> {
018
019    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
020
021    private final ISetDeltaMonitor[] relationD;
022
023    public PropTransitiveUnreachable(SetVar[] relation) {
024        super(relation, PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, true);
025        this.relationD = PropUtil.monitorDeltas(relation, this);
026    }
027
028    @Override
029    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
030        return SetEventType.all();
031    }
032
033    /*
034     * if
035     *   i ---> j
036     *   i -/-> k
037     * then
038     *   j -/-> k
039     */
040    private void forwardPrune(int i) throws ContradictionException {
041        SetVar var = vars[i];
042        ISetIterator jIter = var.getLB().iterator();
043        while (jIter.hasNext()) {
044            int j = jIter.nextInt();
045            if (i != j) {
046                ISetIterator kIter = vars[j].getUB().iterator();
047                while (kIter.hasNext()) {
048                    int k = kIter.nextInt();
049                    if (!var.getUB().contains(k) && vars[j].remove(k, this)) {
050                        onRemoveEnv(j, k);
051                    }
052                }
053            }
054        }
055    }
056
057    /*
058     * if
059     *   i ---> j
060     *   i -/-> k
061     * then
062     *   j -/-> k
063     */
064    private void forwardPruneIJ(int i, int j) throws ContradictionException {
065        SetVar var = vars[i];
066        assert var.getLB().contains(j);
067        ISetIterator iter = var.getUB().iterator();
068        while (iter.hasNext()) {
069            int k = iter.nextInt();
070            if (!var.getUB().contains(k)) {
071                vars[j].remove(k, this);
072                onRemoveEnv(j, k);
073            }
074        }
075    }
076
077    /*
078     * if
079     *   i ---> j
080     *   i -/-> k
081     * then
082     *   j -/-> k
083     */
084    private void forwardPruneIK(int i, int k) throws ContradictionException {
085        SetVar var = vars[i];
086        assert !var.getUB().contains(k);
087        ISetIterator iter = var.getLB().iterator();
088        while (iter.hasNext()) {
089            int j = iter.nextInt();
090            if (i != j && vars[j].remove(k, this)) {
091                onRemoveEnv(j, k);
092            }
093        }
094    }
095
096    /*
097     * if
098     *   i -/-> k
099     *   j ---> k
100     * then
101     *   i -/-> j
102     */
103    private void backwardPrune(int k) throws ContradictionException {
104        int[] backPointers = new int[vars.length];
105        int[] noBackPointers = new int[vars.length];
106        int bs = 0;
107        int nbs = 0;
108        for (int i = 0; i < vars.length; i++) {
109            if (vars[i].getLB().contains(k)) {
110                backPointers[bs++] = i;
111            } else if (!vars[i].getUB().contains(k)) {
112                noBackPointers[nbs++] = i;
113            }
114        }
115        for (int ii = 0; ii < nbs; ii++) {
116            int i = noBackPointers[ii];
117            for (int jj = 0; jj < bs; jj++) {
118                int j = backPointers[jj];
119                if (vars[i].remove(j, this)) {
120                    onRemoveEnv(i, j);
121                }
122            }
123        }
124    }
125
126    /*
127     * if
128     *   i -/-> k
129     *   j ---> k
130     * then
131     *   i -/-> j
132     */
133    private void backwardPruneJK(int j, int k) throws ContradictionException {
134        assert vars[j].getLB().contains(k);
135        for (int i = 0; i < vars.length; i++) {
136            if (i != j && !vars[i].getUB().contains(k) && vars[i].remove(j, this)) {
137                onRemoveEnv(i, j);
138            }
139        }
140    }
141
142    /*
143     * if
144     *   i -/-> k
145     *   j ---> k
146     * then
147     *   i -/-> j
148     */
149    private void backwardPruneIK(int i, int k) throws ContradictionException {
150        SetVar var = vars[i];
151        assert !var.getUB().contains(k);
152        for (int j = 0; j < vars.length; j++) {
153            if (i != j && vars[j].getLB().contains(k) && var.remove(j, this)) {
154                onRemoveEnv(i, j);
155            }
156        }
157    }
158
159    private void onRemoveEnv(int i, int k) throws ContradictionException {
160        assert !vars[i].getUB().contains(k);
161        forwardPruneIK(i, k);
162        backwardPruneIK(i, k);
163    }
164
165    @Override
166    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
167        for (SetVar var : vars) {
168            ISetIterator iter = var.getUB().iterator();
169            while (iter.hasNext()) {
170                int j = iter.nextInt();
171                if (j < 0 || j >= vars.length) {
172                    var.remove(j, this);
173                }
174            }
175        }
176        for (int i = 0; i < vars.length; i++) {
177            forwardPrune(i);
178            backwardPrune(i);
179        }
180        PropUtil.startMonitoring(relationD);
181    }
182
183    @Override
184    public void propagate(final int i, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
185        relationD[i].forEach(j -> {
186            forwardPruneIJ(i, j);
187            backwardPruneJK(i, j);
188        }, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
189        relationD[i].forEach(k -> onRemoveEnv(i, k), SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
190    }
191
192    @Override
193    public ESat isEntailed() {
194        // PropTransitive has it taken care of.
195        return ESat.TRUE;
196    }
197
198    @Override
199    public String toString() {
200        return "transitiveUnreachable(" + Arrays.toString(vars) + ")";
201    }
202}
